system: Newaygo County Parks and Recreation Commission
what: Ordinance #01/2020 (amended 2024) bans hunting on Commission property unless the Commission authorizes it; authorized hunting follows state law and extra Commission rules. Game-camera rule refers to 'areas open to hunting', but no open parks/areas were found. Firearms follow federal/state/local law.
quote: No Person shall hunt any animal in or upon any Commission property unless authorized by the Commission. All hunting will be in accordance with the laws of the State of Michigan...
county_forest_what: No county forest; PAD-US lists Ed Henning Park and a small prairie parcel.
notes: Section 21(a). Effectively permission-only; no designated hunt published. Note: newaygo.gov resolution 2024-18 is the CITY of Newaygo (bans hunting) - not the county.

what: County parks are West Branch Secret Campground & RV Park, Pointer Hill roadside park and Ogemaw Nature Park (animal park). The county's 2019-2023 plan says hunting happens on state/federal forest.
county_forest_what: PAD-US lists a 396-acre county 'Local Forest' with open access, but no county page, plan or policy mentions a county forest or hunting on it.

what: The county park rules bar firearms discharge and hunting/trapping within the park (a campground). PAD-US lists a 3,646-acre county 'Local Forest' but no county forest page, forestry committee or hunting rule was found on the county site.

county_forest_what: 3,646 ac 'Local Forest' (PAD-US, public access OA) not documented on ontonagoncounty.org; likely tax-reverted/county-owned timberland. Hunting status unconfirmed.
